chapter: Dreamland and the Tuxedo dance hall
title: Hiring the best musicians and Papa Tio's reading band
summary: He is asked to gather the best musicians for the new hall, including Papa Tio and George Filhe, and describes an all-reading band using orchestrations.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans
